experiments.scope: Deterministic replay of one published pair of distinct 64-byte messages against complete md5-s63-prefix-v1. The same pair is returned in every organizer trial; duplicate rows are expected and are not independent generator samples.
experiments.hypothesis: The two pinned Table 5 messages have the same complete 128-bit digest when every padded block executes MD5 steps 0 through 62 with the standard IV and feed-forward.
